issues.message: v-for over "items" on <div> is missing a :key binding.
issues.suggestion: Add a unique :key to help Vue track DOM nodes efficiently. Prefer a stable unique id: <div v-for="a in items" :key="a.id">. Using the loop index (:key="index") is a last resort — it disables reordering optimizations and can cause subtle bugs.
